0022600121.text: The Celtics (1-1, 6th in the East and 3rd in the Atlantic, 1 game back) host the Bulls (1-1, 7th in the East and 2nd in the Central, 1 game back), with both teams coming off a win. Boston is without Devin Carter, who is out with an illness, while Chicago is missing Nic Claxton, who is out with a hamstring injury, and Noa Essengue, who is day-to-day with a head bruise. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and Boston won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 124-105 victory over Chicago in Boston on February 11, 2026.
